scope: W2a hardening plus W2b bounded expansion; no dependency edits or independent approval

patches.change: W2b v3 per-tool/operation grants, typed module mode, exact native disabled-tool universe and grant-controlled readonly. Reserve only the fixed read-only EMQX cluster-status / LiteLLM model-list probe in private loopback registration independently of public disables; parent authorization/list filtering remains authoritative, with real backend reads and unchanged readiness validation. Disable FastMCP banner/update checks to prevent unauthenticated PyPI lookup and version-cache pollution of the guarded clean restart directory; never delete or permit unknown CWD contents.
W2b bounded positive output projection: at most 100 rows, 256 characters per scalar string, no nested/unknown fields; wrong envelope rejects. Not a sanitizer for arbitrary agent/file output.

Before stock CLI starts, replace RedirectTransport with configured-origin XMLRPC transport. Deny all redirects, pin validated DNS, retain verified hostname/SNI, sanitize faults; bound SDK sync dispatch to one worker.

Before stock CLI starts, replace both pooled XMLRPC transport classes with configured-origin DNS-pinned transport; keep database header and verified TLS, sanitize faults. W2b source-guarded module authentication/ACL REST helpers now use scoped sync HTTPX transport instead of urllib; fixed API-key-only paths and strict consumed auth/permission types. No full YOLO or backend module installation.
Run actual SDK handlers with four-worker bounded sync dispatch; initialize shared HTTP client before threads and close at launcher shutdown; no schema/permission changes.

Local scoped HTTPX/httpcore and XMLRPC transports. Validate all DNS answers before numeric-address fallback under one DNS/TCP deadline; retain original Host/SNI/TLS. Process-wide four-worker DNS executor with immediate four-slot admission and execution-owned capacity through caller timeout/cancellation, shared by sync/async/XMLRPC and all Hermes clients. Supervisor owns hard process-group shutdown. Embedded _SOURCE_HASHES fail closed on seven locked HTTPX/httpcore implementation files before private pool adaptation. Lazy sync/async response wrappers normalize iteration and close failures, including unmapped httpcore cleanup errors, without buffering or taking over HTTPX/core close ownership. Non-2xx cleanup retains status precedence; cancellation is not caught. Shared type-based public error mapping and explicit enabled-handler decorators cover decoding/JSON failures after transport iteration; successful business values and signatures are unchanged. No global socket/resolver/SSRF modification.
Adapt SDK registered sync function dispatch, preserving validation/output metadata; reject overload, retain capacity through cancellation; child process-group supervisor owns hard shutdown deadline.
